title: Zephyrine and the Sigil
author: Ines Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Sandoval, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
